# Organize taxa names by hierarchy
```{r}
taxamatch <- bind_rows(am_2021_5, am_2023_2, am_2024_2,
                       am_2024_3, am_2024_4, am_2024_5) %>% 
  group_by(object_annotation_category, object_annotation_hierarchy) %>% 
   summarise(nimages = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(object_annotation_hierarchy) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = "") %>% 
  # Separate living and non living to exclude
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("not-living", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Exclude-nonliving", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("other|oversegmented|temporary", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Exclude-living", taxagroup)) %>% 
  # Identify Rhizaria and other major groups
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Rhizaria", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Rhizaria", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Haptophyta", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Haptophyta", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Mollusca", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Mollusca", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Echinodermata", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Echinodermata", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Cnidaria", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Cnidaria", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Ctenophora", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Ctenophora", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Chaetognatha", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Chaetognatha", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Tunicata", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Tunicata", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Annelida", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Annelida", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Eumalacostraca", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Eumalacostraca", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Ostracoda", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Ostracoda", taxagroup)) %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("Copepoda", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Copepoda", taxagroup)) %>%
  # Mark images categorized as with visible lipid sac
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(grepl("with visible lipid sac", object_annotation_hierarchy) == TRUE,
                             "Copepoda-lipidsac", taxagroup)) %>% 
  # Bulk the rest of crustacea parts and fish as Exclude-living
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(taxagroup == "", "Exclude-living", taxagroup))


df <- taxamatch %>% 
  mutate(totalimgs = sum(nimages)) %>% 
  group_by(taxagroup, totalimgs) %>% 
  summarise(nimages = sum(nimages),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(percent = round(nimages / totalimgs * 100,2)) %>% 
  arrange(-nimages)
df
# write.csv(df, file = "tables/UVP6_taxagroup_image_counts.csv", row.names = F)

# Percent of copepod images classified as with lipid sac: 
# 7547/(7547+668758)*100 = 1.1%
```



# Combine all data
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# 1. Prepare the volume data from Ecopart
# These can be accessed through the individual EcoPart output files inside C:\Sync\UVP6_Data\Ecopart. Here use the organized Ecopart output of the particle concentrations which contain the volume information in 5 m bins.
load("data/UVP6_ECOPART_Data_20251121.RData")

# 2. Filter only the living portion
Amund_UVP6 <- bind_rows(am_2021_5, am_2023_2, am_2024_2,
                        am_2024_3, am_2024_4, am_2024_5) %>% 
  left_join(taxamatch %>% select(object_annotation_category, taxagroup),
            by = "object_annotation_category") %>% 
  filter(taxagroup != "Exclude-nonliving") %>% 
  filter(taxagroup != "Exclude-living") 

# TODO rename morphotraits?
# Major = object_major, Minor = object_minor, Perim. = object_perim.,
#          Feret = object_feret, Area = object_area, Elongation = object_elongation,
#          Ver.Sym. = object_symetriev, Ver.Sym.2 = object_symetrievc, 
#          Circ. = object_circ., Thickr = object_thickr, 
#          Mean.grey = object_mean, Med.grey = object_median,
#          `Hist.grey 75%` = object_histcum3, 
#          Sdev.grey = object_stddev, Skew.grey = object_skew,
#          Fractal = object_fractal, 
#          `Perim./Feret` = object_perimferet,
#          `Perim./Major` = object_perimmajor

# Correct some metadata errors
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(object_lon = if_else(sample_stationid == "LSea-23",
                              -abs(object_lon), object_lon))

# Match sample to volume (+- 2.5)
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_PAR %>% 
              select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L),
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)


# 3. Organize the nonliving fraction to size classes for POC flux calculation?
# Note that this starts at the 700 um size class (if based on the major axis).
Amund_UVP6_detritus <- bind_rows(am_2021_5, am_2023_2, am_2024_2,
                                 am_2024_3, am_2024_4, am_2024_5) %>% 
  left_join(taxamatch %>% select(object_annotation_category, taxagroup),
            by = "object_annotation_category") %>% 
  # Categorize all living as living
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(taxagroup == "Exclude-nonliving", 
                             "detritus","living")) %>% 
  select(object_id:object_major, taxagroup) %>% 
  # Calculate size (based on major axis * 73 um)
  mutate(size_um = object_major * 73) %>% 
  # Add 5 m depth bin and sample volume
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_max / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_PAR %>% 
              select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L),
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)

# Assign size class based on the 45 detailed group of EcoPart
part_scs <- uvp6_par_cnames %>% 
  filter(grepl("concentration",AnnotatedColumnName) == T) %>% 
  mutate(size_class = str_remove(AnnotatedColumnName, "concentration_")) %>% 
  select(-c(OrigColumnName, AnnotatedColumnName))
part_scs$Upper_limit_um[45] <- 10000 # to add an "upper limit"

Amund_UVP6_detritus <- Amund_UVP6_detritus %>% 
  inner_join(part_scs,
             by = join_by(
               size_um >= Lower_limit_um,
               size_um < Upper_limit_um
             ))

# Count the number of detritus and living by sample, depth, and size class 
Amund_UVP6_detritus_summary <- Amund_UVP6_detritus %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L, taxagroup, 
           size_class, Lower_limit_um, Upper_limit_um) %>% 
  summarise(nimages = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(concentration_L = nimages/Sampled_volume_L) %>% 
  # Calculate percent detritus in each sample, depth, and size class
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, size_class) %>% 
  mutate(total_imgs = sum(nimages)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(percent_total = nimages / total_imgs * 100) %>% 
  select(-total_imgs)


summary( (Amund_UVP6_detritus_summary %>% 
            filter(taxagroup == "detritus") )$percent_total)
sd( (Amund_UVP6_detritus_summary %>% 
            filter(taxagroup == "detritus") )$percent_total)
```


# Explore sampling metadata
Note that there may be multiple casts in the same station
```{r, eval=FALSE}
# TODO need to get actual station depths for filtering "shallow" stations

Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  # Calculate deepest sample depth
  mutate(nimages = n(),
         maxSampleDepth = max(object_depth_max)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-c(object_depth_max:Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  # Add total volume info
  left_join(uvp6_profiles %>% 
              select(sample_id, total_volume_L),
            by = join_by(sample_id)) %>% 
  # Establish DOY, Year
  mutate(Year = year(object_date),
         Month = month(object_date),
         DOY = yday(object_date))


# Establish Twilight (UTC dates provided?) based on solar angle for the date with SunTools
# Note that in summer, may be all during daytime
df.twilight <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  select(sample_id, object_lon, object_lat, object_date, object_time, 
         Year, Month, DOY) %>% 
  mutate(fullDate = as.POSIXct(paste(object_date, object_time),
                                     tz = "UTC")) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(dawn = crepuscule(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           solarDep = 6,
                           direction = "dawn",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>%

  mutate(dusk = crepuscule(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           solarDep = 6,
                           direction = "dusk",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(sunrise = sunriset(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           direction = "sunrise",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(sunset = sunriset(matrix(c(object_lon, object_lat), nrow = 1),
                           fullDate,
                           direction = "sunset",
                           POSIXct.out = TRUE)) %>% 
  # TODO Decide what to assign as night/day
  mutate(twilight = if_else(fullDate >= dawn$time & fullDate < dusk$time,
                            "Day", ""),
         twilight = if_else(fullDate >= dusk$time | fullDate < dawn$time,
                            "Night", twilight)) %>% 
  # If NA during August at high latitude, that indicates day time
  mutate(twilight = if_else(is.na(twilight), "Day", twilight))

# Assign twilight in data frames
Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  left_join(df.twilight %>% select(sample_id, twilight),
            by = "sample_id")
Amund_UVP6 <- Amund_UVP6 %>% 
  left_join(df.twilight %>% select(sample_id, twilight),
            by = "sample_id")

# Confirm twilight assignment
ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta, aes(x = DOY, y = object_time, color = twilight,
                            shape = as.factor(Year))) +
  geom_point() +
  ylab("Time (UTC)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(182,213,244,274,305),
                     labels = c("Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov"))

```

# Check size class binning
```{r}
test_profile <- "am_leg5_TCA_BB2_04" #amundsen2023_105_1

# sample profile from ecopart (start with size class 29: 700 um +)
df_ecopart <- uvp6_PAR %>% 
  filter(sample_id == test_profile) %>% 
  select(sample_id:Sampled_volume_L, 
         concentration_sc_29:concentration_sc_45) %>% 
  # elongate to size class per row
  pivot_longer(cols = concentration_sc_29:concentration_sc_45,
               names_to = "size_class", 
               values_to = "concen_ecopart") %>% 
  
  mutate(size_class = str_remove(size_class, "concentration_")) %>% 
  filter(concen_ecopart > 0)

df_recalc <- Amund_UVP6_detritus_summary %>% 
  select(-c(Lower_limit_um, Upper_limit_um, percent_total, nimages)) %>% 
  filter(sample_id == test_profile) %>% 
  # Concentration in /L
  pivot_wider(names_from = taxagroup, values_from = concentration_L,
              values_fill = 0) %>% 
  mutate(concen_total = detritus + living) %>% 
  rename(concen_detritus = detritus, concen_living = living) %>% 
  select(sample_id, size_class, Depth_5m,
         volume_recalc = Sampled_volume_L,
         concen_total, concen_detritus, concen_living)

# Combine to check
df_combined <- full_join(df_ecopart, df_recalc,
                         by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m, size_class))


# Should be the safe if recalculation exactly matches the Ecopart algorithm
sum(df_combined$concen_ecopart, na.rm = T)
sum(df_combined$concen_total, na.rm = T)

ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = concen_ecopart, y = concen_total,
                        color = size_class)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()
```
